description: Tools you can call through POST /v1/tools/{id}, paid from the same balance and key as chat, each with its price in USDF (what it costs plus 5% at most) and the input it takes, ordered by title. Every tool listed can be called now. q keeps the tools whose id, title or description has those words; a page holds up to 200, and page.next names the next one. No key needed.
